column1: # Charon r409: the RHVoice voices of rhvoice.tts and their names elsewhere. Tab separated, UTF-8.
# charon_id       id in rhvoice.manifest ("voice = id | name | language") and in CharonSynthVoice.id: "rhvoice-" + lower-case RHVoice name.
# rhvoice_name    the voice's name in voice.info = RHVoice voice profile = Speech Dispatcher synthesis voice (spd-say -o rhvoice -y NAME),
#                 NVDA/SAPI5 voice name. Matching in RHVoice is case-insensitive.
# version         voice.info format.revision at the pinned commit (the submodule commit of RHVoice 1.18.5).
# licence         RHVoice-unrestricted: no statement in the voice repository; RHVoice's doc/en/License.md lists restrictions only for
#                 other voices and Debian files it under GPL-2+ (data/*). CMU-ARCTIC: the festvox CMU ARCTIC database licence.
# data_url        official data archive (github.com/RHVoice/packages, branch main); data_sha256 as downloaded 2026-11-23.
# debian_ubuntu_package  one package per language, component non-free (Debian) / multiverse (Ubuntu); debian_since = oldest Debian
#                 release whose package contains this voice ("-" = not in Debian 1.14.0-3: install from upstream data).
# arch_package    Arch Linux [extra] (rhvoice 1.16.5; dasha-eng only from 1.18.5), plus rhvoice-language-polish / -english.
# fedora          not in Fedora; COPR lostmemories/RHVoice has one package "rhvoice" (English voices; no Polish package listed).
# nvda_addon_url, sapi5_url  newest official packages on github.com/RHVoice ("-" = none published there; RHVoice Lab voices: rhvoice.su).
